description: This file defines a React Native component named DevBulkPinScreen, which provides a developer utility interface for bulk pinning and unpinning notes, with a list displaying note titles and pinned statuses.

methods.name: DevBulkPinScreen
methods.description: React component for bulk pinning/unpinning notes and displaying the notes list.

methods.name: pinAll
methods.description: Pins all notes and updates their 'updatedAt' timestamp.

methods.name: unpinAll
methods.description: Unpins all notes and updates their 'updatedAt' timestamp.
